# Terminal dependencies

Vendored from the published npm packages via https://unpkg.com/:
- `@xterm/xterm@6.0.0`: lib/xterm.js, css/xterm.css, LICENSE.
- `@xterm/addon-fit@0.11.0`: lib/addon-fit.js, LICENSE.

Assets are embedded in the application. No CDN is accessed at runtime.
Security reference: https://xtermjs.org/docs/guides/security/
The terminal icon is Lucide Static 0.468.0, under the existing assets/icons/LICENSE.
